create_CSVFormatter: create a CSVFormatter instance to format a pandas DataFrame into CSV output with configurable separators, encoding, and compression
run_CSVFormatter_save: run the CSVFormatter save method to write a DataFrame to a CSV file with headers and chunked body rows
build_multiindex_csv_header: build multiindex CSV header rows by generating per-level column name rows with index labels for pandas DataFrames
test_CSVFormatter_index_label: test the CSVFormatter index label initialization for flat and multiindex index cases
refactor_CSVFormatter_chunksize: refactor the CSVFormatter chunksize initialization to automatically compute chunk size from total cells and column count
